news.body:
## CareerGlobe is the only thing left in the way
- You closed the CareerLeader and Career Anchors questionnaires on 18 October.
They were one of the two things holding up your first CDC coaching session. The other is the CareerGlobe profile, dated the 27th and about an hour's work, and once it is done the 15 November booking is yours to make whenever you want it.

## Monday is the last CV review slot
- The CDC is running three, on the 22nd, 23rd and 26th, and today's is the second.
Monday is also the day your LMS tutorials are due, and the Google and Amazon applications close on 8 November. Your VMock CV has been in the green since the 11th, so the review is the last step between that score and four applications. - If Monday is the slot you take, move the LMS tutorials to the weekend.
